definitions.explanation: A suffix indicating the number of years since an event, used for anniversaries.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧10{周年|しゅうねん}。
⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦{設立|せつりつ}→設立：14171_setsuritsu⟧50{周年|しゅうねん}。
⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧30{周年|しゅうねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: Next month marks their 30th wedding anniversary.

notes:
{周年|しゅうねん} is a suffix/noun meaning "anniversary" — the number of complete years since an event.

COMMON PATTERNS:
[number] + {周年|しゅうねん} = [number]th anniversary

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧10{周年|しゅうねん}: 10th wedding anniversary
- ⟦{創業|そうぎょう}→創業：11792_sougyou⟧50{周年|しゅうねん}: 50th anniversary of founding
- ⟦{開店|かいてん}→開店：14569_kaiten⟧1{周年|しゅうねん}: 1st anniversary of opening
- 〜{周年|しゅうねん}⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧: ~th anniversary commemoration
- 〜{周年|しゅうねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to mark/celebrate a ~th anniversary

USAGE:
Often seen in sales and marketing: ⟦{創業|そうぎょう}→創業：11792_sougyou⟧100{周年|しゅうねん}⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧ (100th founding anniversary sale). Also common for personal milestones like wedding anniversaries.
Do not confuse with ⟦{執念|しゅうねん}→執念：15429_shuunen⟧ (tenacity, obsession), which has different kanji despite similar pronunciation.
